a position on a $46 million delivery order on the Enterprise-Wide Agile Acquisition Contract Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity contract supporting the U.S. Air Force's Carriage Equipment Production Effort for the Long-Range Standoff (LRSO) cruise missile program.
The LRSO program is a critical modernization effort for the U.S. Air Force and an essential component of the nation's strategic deterrent.
Designed for deployment from the B-52 Stratofortress, the long-range cruise missile will replace the currently fielded air-launched cruise missiles.

Under the contract, V2X will provide carriage equipment production supporting the integration of the LRSO weapon system on the B-52, reinforcing the company's role in advancing next-generation defense capabilities that strengthen mission readiness and national security.

title: V2X awarded position on $46M U.S. Air Force contract
